Metadata.title: NEWTEC TRAVEL AND TOURS | US–Vietnam Flights
Metadata.description: Live fares from San Francisco, Los Angeles, Seattle, Chicago, and five other US cities to Vietnam, handled personally by Hanh Newtec at NEWTEC Travel and Tours in Daly City — flights, seat arrangements, visas, and everything in between.

Footer.tagline: I look after the whole trip between the US and Vietnam for you: the flights, the seats you sit in, the visas, and every little thing in between.
Footer.disclaimer: Sending a request does not hold a seat. I confirm your fare and every detail with you before your ticket is issued.
Footer.specialistLine: Can’t wait to help with your trip,

Home.title: Let me take care of your trip to Vietnam.
Home.description: I’m a travel specialist, and I’ve spent thirty years arranging trips between the US and Vietnam. Tell me where you want to go and when. Have a look at live fares from the US to Vietnam, send me the one you like, and I’ll come back to you myself. Flights, seat arrangements, visas, and everything in between.
Home.priceNote: Every price you see here is the whole trip — the booking, your seats, your visa, your pre-arrival QR code, and everything else I take care of before you fly.
Home.closingTitle: Ready when you are. Let me take it from here.
Home.specialistTitle: You get me, from your first message until the trip is over — and for every trip after that.
Home.specialistBody: I’m Hanh Newtec, and I’ve been arranging flights between the Bay Area and Vietnam from the same little office in Daly City for three decades. A lot of the families who wrote to me at the beginning still come to me first today, and many of them have become friends. Your dates, your fare, your seats, your visa, your pre-arrival QR code, and your ticket all go through me, never through a booking engine.

Inquiry.title: Send this one over to me
Inquiry.description: Your flight stays right here with you the whole way. Tell me how to reach you and who is traveling, and I’ll check the fare and come back to you myself.

travelers.assistance: Your dates and anything you need on board
travelers.assistanceHint: If your dates can move, tell me here how far and which way — a day earlier out, a few days later back, or a whole week that would work. Same box for anything you need on board. Please do not include medical records or passport numbers.
travelers.assistancePlaceholder: Could leave a day earlier, could come back any day that week, wheelchair assistance, seating needs…

passengers.title: Who is traveling?
passengers.description: Give me each traveler’s name exactly as their passport spells it.
passengers.optionalNote: None of this is required to send your request. Leave it blank and I’ll ask you when we speak — the sooner I have the names, the sooner I can block a fare for you.
passengers.holdBody: When your request reaches me, I use your passport names to block the lowest fare I can find. If you buy, you get that price. If you don’t, it cancels on its own and nothing is charged. Just make sure the names match the passport exactly — a ticket in the wrong name costs money to fix.
passengers.nameHint: Exactly as printed on the passport.

contact.title: How can I reach you?
contact.description: I’ll only use these for your trip, and for anything important that comes up along the way.
contact.phoneHint: Include the country code when outside the U.S.
contact.visaNoteBody: For processing of Vietnam visa, we will need a Passport copy of the first page, headshot picture and Vietnam address. We’ll reach out with more details.
contact.flexibleDatesTitle: My dates could move by a day or two
contact.flexibleDatesBody: Tick this if your departure or return could be off by 1–2 days, and Hanh will find the best prices for your needs. Use the box below to tell me exactly how your departure or return could move.
contact.contactMethodHint: I ask for both so I can still find you if one doesn’t work.

review.title: Review your request
review.description: Have a quick look, then let me know I can contact you about this trip.
review.notesHint: Please do not enter passport numbers, payment, or medical information here.
review.transactionalConsent: I agree to receive service messages about this request by email and, if provided, phone.
review.partyDataAuthority: I am authorized to provide trip details for every traveler in this request.
review.marketingConsent: I would also like occasional travel updates. (Optional)
review.noPurchaseBody: No payment is taken when you send this form. I use your travelers’ details to hold the seats where I can, and I go through the whole price with you before anything is ticketed.

common.contactBody: Ask me directly — you will reach me, not a call centre. I am happy to explain anything on this page before you send a request.

privacy.title: How I handle your information
privacy.intro: I ask for only what I need to price your trip and come back to you. I do not sell your information, I do not share it outside my agency, and I do not use it to advertise to you.
privacy.section1Body: Your name, email address, phone number, preferred language, the trip you are asking about, and anything you write in the assistance or notes fields. I never ask for passport, payment, or medical details on this site — those come later, directly with me, once we are actually booking.
privacy.section2Body: Your request comes to my office by email and appears on a staff-only page so I can research your options and get back to you. I use it to answer you and to arrange the trip you asked about, and for nothing else. No advertising lists, no data brokers, no third parties beyond the airlines and suppliers your own booking requires.
privacy.section3Title: Keeping it, and getting it removed
privacy.section3Body: The staff page is password protected and holds only the details above. I keep your request while I am helping you, and afterwards for the records an accredited travel agency is expected to keep. Email me any time to ask what I have on file, correct it, or have it deleted, and I will take care of it.

terms.title: How booking with me works
terms.intro: Nothing on this site charges you or commits you to anything. Here is what the prices mean, what happens when you send a request, and what I take care of once you do.
terms.section1Body: Fares on this site come straight from my airline partners, and every price shown covers the whole package I arrange for you — not the seat alone. They are not held seats and not issued tickets: fares and availability can move until a ticket is issued, so I always confirm the final price with you before anything is booked.
terms.section2Title: Sending a request is not a purchase
terms.section2Body: Sending the form costs nothing, holds nothing, and takes no payment — this site never asks for a card. I check the exact fare in my agency’s authorized reservation system, come back to you with it, and we arrange the booking and the payment together once you are happy with it.
terms.section3Title: How I reach you, and what I look after
terms.section3Body: I ask for both an email address and a phone number so I can still reach you if one of them fails, and I only contact you about the request you sent. Alongside your flights I handle Vietnam visa paperwork, seat requests, special assistance, and any changes later on. Group travel and business class discounts I quote by hand, so send me a request for those.

accessibility.title: Designed for more travelers
accessibility.intro: I build this site to WCAG 2.2 AA, and if anything here gets in your way I want to hear about it so I can fix it.
accessibility.section1Body: Searching, choosing a flight, and sending a request all work with a keyboard, read correctly with a screen reader, keep focus visible, list errors plainly, use targets large enough to tap, and describe every icon that carries meaning.
accessibility.section2Body: Tell me about mobility, communication, seating, or any other assistance you need in the request form and I will arrange it with the airline. Please keep it to what the airline needs to know — no private medical records.
accessibility.section3Body: Email me with the page, your device, your browser, and a short description of what went wrong. I will find another way to help you straight away while I get it fixed.
